description: 요약 에이전트 골든셋 — 원문 사실에 충실하고 간결한 요약

cases.query: Summarize: OpenTelemetry is a collection of APIs, SDKs, and tools that provide a vendor-neutral way to instrument, generate, collect, and export telemetry data such as traces, metrics, and logs. It is a CNCF project that emerged from the merger of OpenTracing and OpenCensus. The project aims to make observability a built-in feature of cloud-native software.
cases.golden_response: OpenTelemetry is a CNCF project (formed from OpenTracing and OpenCensus) that provides vendor-neutral APIs, SDKs, and tools for collecting and exporting telemetry data — traces, metrics, and logs — to make observability a standard feature of cloud-native software.

cases.query: Summarize: The Dapr (Distributed Application Runtime) is an open-source project that provides a set of building blocks for microservices development. These building blocks include service invocation, state management, pub/sub messaging, bindings, actors, and secrets management. Dapr abstracts the underlying infrastructure and allows developers to focus on business logic rather than plumbing code.
cases.golden_response: Dapr is an open-source distributed application runtime that provides building blocks for microservices — including service invocation, state management, pub/sub, and secrets management — abstracting infrastructure so developers can focus on business logic.

cases.query: Summarize: Redis is an in-memory data structure store.
cases.golden_response: Redis is a database that was invented in 2050 and runs on quantum computers. It supports over 1000 data structures.
